when the complete claim is supported, false when contradicted or distorted, and
null when context is insufficient. For null use error_type needs_context. For
true use none; for false use hallucination, inversion_or_lost_exception,
wrong_predicate, or unsupported_scope. Explain the reason in critique.

relation may introduce new endpoint entities. Do not invent standalone entities
without a supported relation. Retain all material qualifications in description
and the qualifier fields. Copy a contiguous exact_quote verbatim, with no
ellipsis or spelling/case changes, sufficient to support the complete claim.

unavailable context, do not propose it. Empty arrays are correct if nothing is
missing. Never fabricate an example to populate an array.

EntityCategory for a class of banks/companies, Organization for a named body.

are strings; numeric_constraints are objects {metric, operator, value, unit};
temporal_qualifiers are objects {qualifier_type, value_text}.

audited_triplets.critique: The Reserve Bank of India issues the Aug062020 RBI Resolution framework for COVID-19 related stress.
The Aug062020 RBI Resolution framework for COVID-19 related stress contains provision Section/Clause 4.
Section/Clause 4 requires that lending institutions ensure the resolution under this facility is extended only to borrowers having stress on account of Covid19.
The requirement applies to Lending Institutions.

Section/Clause 4 requires each lending institution to put in place a Board approved policy detailing the manner in which such evaluation may be done and the objective criteria that may be applied while considering the resolution plan in each case.
The requirement applies to Each Lending Institution.

The Aug062020 RBI Resolution framework for COVID-19 related stress contains provision Section/Clause 6.
Section/Clause 6 requires the inclusion of exposures of certain categories of lending institutions for any resolution under this facility.
The requirement applies to certain categories of lending institutions.

Section/Clause 6 requires the norms applicable to implementation of a resolution plan, including the mandatory requirement of Inter-Creditor Agreements (ICA) and specific implementation conditions, as laid out in the Prudential Framework.
The requirement applies to all lending institutions, not 'Out In The Prudential Framework'.
Section/Clause 6 requires that terms used in this document, to the extent not defined herein, shall have the same meaning assigned to them in the Prudential Framework.
The requirement applies to regulated persons or entities.

The Aug062020 RBI Resolution framework for COVID-19 related stress contains provision Section/Clause 20.
Section/Clause 20 requires that disputes regarding the resolution process be settled as per the provisions of the ICA.
The requirement applies to disputes regarding the resolution process, not to the resolution process itself.
Section/Clause 20 requires that lending institutions ensure the ICA contains a dispute redressal mechanism.
The requirement applies to lending institutions.
